label: GO WITH CONDITIONS
recommendation: Ask for $75 an hour, structured as $55 now and $75 automatically at day 90 against three targets the COO signs first. Bring a one-page proof sheet worth at least $156k a year.
conditions: Proof sheet by Nov 1: three sourced dollar figures totalling at least $156k a year
COO signs three day-90 targets before $55 starts, with $75 as the automatic result
Runbooks for core systems; someone else runs one by day 30
Meeting held by Nov 8, COO first, then CEO
next_steps: By Nov 1: build the proof sheet and draft the three targets
By Nov 8: meet the COO, then the CEO
Day 90: check targets and move to $75
cheapest_test: Get the COO to initial one line of the proof sheet before booking the CEO meeting.
kill_criteria: If no figure survives the COO's check, do not ask yet. If the answer is 'not now' with no date, decide privately whether to stay.
